subject: GITHUB_REPOSITORY_CONSOLIDATION_REF_CLEANUP_PHASE_A
observation_sources: GitHub connector PR #15 conversation, reviews and review threads

open_prs.head: plan/group-b-prerequisite-minimal-closure-001
open_prs.decision_reason: Draft Group B prerequisite coordination PR retains a 2026-09-21 gate and older base/head while main has advanced through Group B, Group C and 2.7.4; current complete discussion shows no active review dependency. Separate USER_LOCAL authority and fresh revalidation are required before any close.

classification_limits: Branch-level GitHub API reports protected=false for all 91 refs; detailed branch-protection endpoint returned 403 and therefore supplies no independent policy detail.
No branch is DELETE_SAFE because active-work, review, bootstrap and authority predicates are not all positively resolved; ancestry alone is insufficient.
PR decision is classification only. Any metadata action needs later independent review, GPT adjudication, user authority, immutable locator and fresh ref checks.
